subscription.faqQ1: How do I upgrade my plan?
subscription.faqA1: Click the "Upgrade" button below your desired plan and follow the prompts to complete payment. Upgrades take effect immediately, and the current billing cycle fee is prorated.
subscription.faqQ2: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
subscription.faqA2: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. After cancellation, your plan will downgrade to the free tier at the end of the current billing cycle.
subscription.faqA3: We support credit cards, debit cards, and other major payment methods through Stripe. All payment information is securely processed by Stripe.
subscription.faqQ4: Is there a member limit for the Team plan?
subscription.faqA4: The Team plan supports up to 10 members by default. For more seats, please contact our sales team for a custom enterprise plan.

legal.termsContent:
Welcome to Small-Squaretable. By using our service, you agree to these terms.

1. Acceptance of Terms
By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

2. User Accounts
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password.

3. Acceptable Use
You agree not to misuse the service or help anyone else do so.

4. Content
You retain ownership of content you create. By posting content, you grant us a license to display it.

5. Termination
We may suspend or terminate your access at any time for violations of these terms.

6. Changes
We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
legal.privacyContent:
Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.

1. Information We Collect
We collect information you provide directly, such as account details and chat content.

2. How We Use Information
We use your information to provide and improve our services.

3. Data Storage
Your data is stored securely and we implement appropriate security measures.

4. Third-Party Services
We may use third-party services for analytics and payment processing.

5. Your Rights
You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data.

6. Contact
For privacy-related questions, please contact our support team.
legal.aboutContent:
Small-Squaretable is a next-generation AI character platform that brings your imagination to life.

Our mission is to create the most engaging and creative AI conversation experience. We combine cutting-edge language models with an intuitive interface to let you create, customize, and chat with AI characters.

Features:
- Create and customize AI characters
- Real-time chat with advanced AI
- Character marketplace for sharing creations
- Multi-language support

Built with passion by the Small-Squaretable team.
